decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=PATH_REF{ (index=1,generation=0), (index=0xBEEF,generation=7) }, src=/reply-ep, VALUE u32=9 } — a bound request as it ARRIVES at a forwarder: two elements are left, so this host is a hop and not the terminus.
decoded.note: RFC-0024 §4.1/§5.1. Element 0 is THIS host's reference to its next-hop connection vertex; element 1 means nothing here and is carried through untouched.
